name: Cylostra Direfin
canonNotes: A drowned Bretonnian prima donna, now a vengeful ghost whose Lamprey appears in storms, her songs of death paralysing sailors.
Vain and furious at her unfinished performance for the Phoenix King.
voiceNotes: Theatrical, vain and tempestuous; speaks of audiences, songs and encores.
Swings between grand charm and shrieking fury.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
